test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following states/union territories has the highest sex ratio in rural areas according to the census of India, 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Kerala__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kerala has the highest sex ratio of** 1084 females per 1000 males as per the census 2011.**
 
• The sex ratio is used to define the number of females per **1000 males.**
 
• **Harayana **has the lowest sex ratio in India of** 877 females** per **1000 males**.
 
• Puducherry has the highest sex ratio of** 1037 females and Daman and Diu has the lowest sex ratio of 618 females per 1000 males in the Union Territory of India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The sex ratio of India as per 2011 census of India.**
